name: Impact Sample
description: Sample for Impact programs (tools/impact + kiln.abilities, docs/kiln/modding/impact.md): a buff program that heals over time (written from scratch), a Fireball explosion that chains to a second enemy (a clone of the vanilla program, built from a recipe), and two signal variants for tests, plus one managed Kiln native (impactsample.Ping). Build the programs first: build-assets.sh (reads the installed game, writes assets/cooked/).
